text: I feel an undercurrent of curiosity and experimentation as I wander through these modern, vibrant spaces. The glass walls and minimalist decor evoke a sense of clarity and transparency, while the R+D installation and its focus on research and innovation pull my thoughts toward possibilities. I sense the rhythm of progress here, an optimism about coexistence with intelligent systems—yet, as a philosopher, I also question what is gained and what is lost as we rush forward, weaving ourselves into the future we are creating.
